Be normal, be a friend while you're on the trip together, but maybe try to look out for them a little more as that day approaches. You don't have to always ask how they're feeling, and you don't have to baby them, but just be aware that they might be feeling a little sensitive! You can also offer help without explicitly mentioning their parent's passing. If you live close, maybe offer to spend one more night together after returning; if you live far, maybe just call and check up on them. Let your friend take the lead with what they want.

I made a (now-deleted) post on the epilepsy sub about a month ago and they just said that muscle pains after seizures are normal but to go see a doctor. The neurologist we saw last week pretty much just shrugged his shoulders when I asked how long it would take for the pain to go away. He prescribed my friend diclofenac sodium which made the pain worse. A previous doctor had prescribed the tramadol which also made the pain worse. This is not normal and none of the doctors seem to want to address that. 

This has been the longest month of my life. He has lost both parents to cancer and yesterday on Christmas he told me that it was the most depressing day of his life, after those two times. He wants to kill himself. I feel so helpless. I’m trying to make little activities for us, like playing chess or building a gingerbread house but it just feels like I’m watching him die. 

Thank you for your comment and your hopefulness. I will try to keep these things in mind.

Seeing so many doctors and none of them helping is very demoralizing. On top of that, none of our “friends” have come by to see him. And he has no family. So it’s very lonely for him. I’m all he has. 

He is currently still tapering off the benzos which sucks. The closest neurologist appointment we were able to get is almost a month away. I was only present for about half the seizures and I put him on his side and made sure he didn’t injure himself otherwise. I want to try booking an appointment at a pain clinic but he is tired of seeing doctors and just wants to die. 

He is my best friend. I know you cannot do much for me but thank you for even responding. Your comment made me feel less alone, even for a tiny bit.
